description: [No sign-in required] Download the current issuer keys online before verifying a saved result offline. Match the signature’s key ID in keys[] and confirm its SHA-256 fingerprint independently. If a saved bundle lacks that key, fetch the current bundle. Pass it with the exported record to /developers/verify-conformity.mjs. For the current state of a disclosed result, call getResultStatus.
name: getTrustBundle

outputSchema.description: Issuer trust bundle for offline record and status verification.

keys.description: Issuer keys and their trust status.

items.description: A public issuer key. Historical keys can also specify a validity window.

fingerprintSha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint to confirm through a trusted channel.

keyId.description: Identifier referenced by the signed artifact.

purposes.description: Declared signing uses for this key.

validFrom.description: Start of this key’s declared validity window, when published.

validUntil.description: End of this key’s declared validity window, when published.

title: Download issuer verification keys
